items.label: speed：每次测速度，距离能随意换吗？
items.prompt: 每次测速度，距离能随意换吗？
items.material: Measure the speed over the same distance each time.

items.reason: speed是速度。over the same distance each time要求每次在相同距离内测量，不是每次换距离，也不是说每次速度必然相同；原句没有给具体距离、时间或速度。

transfer.stem: Which notes preserve the meaning of space, the orbital roles and the measurement condition?
transfer.passage:
From the sky to a moving cart
At our exhibition, a telescope revealed details on the moon. The record gave no exact magnification or list of those details. A display explored our place in the universe. One model showed a planet moving around a star, without giving an orbital period. Another display described a satellite sending weather images back to Earth, rather than carrying passengers.
In the activity room, we had to leave space between boxes so that air could circulate. Here, space meant room between objects, not outer space. Gravity pulled a ball back to the ground. The record did not state its fall time or height. A small force moved an empty cart. A separate fictional cart animation illustrated movement without measuring a real force, mass or speed.
The last instruction was to measure speed over the same distance each time. It did not say that every speed had to be identical. We had to preserve the distance condition instead of inventing a speed or changing the distance for each trial.

options.text: Space means outer space; the star moves around the planet; speed must be identical each time.
Space means a gap; the planet moves around the star; use the same distance each time.
Space means a gap; the star moves around the planet; use the same distance each time.
Space means a gap; the planet moves around the star; use a different distance each time.

answer.display: Space means a gap; the planet moves around the star; use the same distance each time.
